messages.content: Checkout is returning 500s in prod right after the 14:20 deploy. The error is relation orders_v2 does not exist.
The migration did not run because the release job still uses the old migration image tag. App and migration tags drifted.
We decided to roll back the app now and fix forward after the incident is contained.
Rollback command: kubectl rollout undo deployment/checkout -n prod. Then watch the rollout status before touching anything else.
Gotcha: rollback alone leaves the new migration job spec in place. Pin the migration image to the same tag as the app or the next deploy will drift again.
Verification: /healthz returns 200 for five minutes and the 5xx rate is below 0.1 percent. I will post the dashboard link in the incident channel.
Follow-up: add a deploy gate that fails when the migration image tag and app image tag differ. That is the actual root cause.
